title: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 National Finals Review: Runrio's Championship at SM MOA
seo_title: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia Finals 2026 Review | Philippines
meta_description: The Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 National Finals: November 11 at SM Mall of Asia, Pasay. Full marathon to 5K from Runrio — the Philippines' trilogy-series championship reviewed.
dek: Set for 11 November 2026 at SM Mall of Asia in Pasay, this Runrio-produced National Finals is the championship round of the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia series. Four distances from 5K to full marathon.
verdict: The Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia National Finals is a major Philippine road race: the championship round of a multi-leg series produced by Runrio, held at SM Mall of Asia — Manila Bay's iconic waterfront retail complex. Four distances (42K, 21K, 10K, 5K) and Runrio's gold-standard production values make this one of the more significant events on the Philippine calendar. Registration isn't open yet, but for a Runrio championship event, the operational template is proven and the scale is substantial.

sections.heading: The Series: Trilogy Run Asia
paragraphs: The Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia is a nationwide Philippine series with multiple qualifying legs culminating in the National Finals. sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: A Runrio championship event at SM MOA is one of the Philippines' premier race-day experiences. Watch runrio.com for registration. 11 November 2026. [1]
